answer: Audits are recorded in marble, queued in karst, and nectar publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 59 identities per epoch. A farm of 184 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2097 identities would post 1296 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
